text:
maria: Quick heads-up: perf regression on Mixtral-8x in prod after yesterday's runtime kernel-selector tweak — KV cache memory spikes when fp8 enabled. profile + logs attached.

sam: seeing same on qbench. alloc spike at kv_store::write() around 1.2s into request for seq_len=2048.

devon: ran microbench on my laptop: enabling fp8-kv reduces KV footprint ~38% but tail latency +6-12% at seq=2048 for Llama2-13B. snippet:
```
kv_write    1.24s
quantize_fp8_path 0.72s
fallback_to_fp16   0.43s   # slow memcpy/convert
``` 

leo: could be RoPE scaling change from the kernel selector — if head_kv_dim doesn't match expected quant layout we hit slow fallback path.

maria: stacktrace shows kv_store.cpp:241 -> quantize_fp8_path -> fallback_to_fp16(). reproducer attached.

sam: quick workaround: set `eviction_threshold=0.85` and `prefetch=false` in runtime config. removes spike but increases cache miss rate.
```
runtime.kv.precision=fp8
runtime.kv.eviction_threshold=0.85
runtime.kv.prefetch=false
```

devon: I'll add a unit test for kernel selector: inject head_kv_dim mismatch and assert we choose quant kernel or explicit fast path — not fallback. test plan: `bazel test //eng/runtime:kv_kernel_selector_test --runs_per_test=50`.

perf-bot: [perf-alert] job/runtimectrl/1764130450 flagged regression >10% for mixtral-8x Llama2-13B seq2048

maria: plan: devon adds test + mem-bench; sam will run a canary rollout with forced-eviction patch in one pool; I'll open a single-pool canary and watch kv_quant_fallback_count :eyes:.

devon: will also probe bf16 path — earlier bench showed bf16 cache perf comparable to fp16 but no fallback churn.

leo: if fallback occurs we should emit metric `kv_quant_fallback_count` and surface on Redwood Console per-model. alert if >5/min.

maria: added console alert and a dashboard tile for kv_quant_fallback_count. will post PRs shortly.
